Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.ott

package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.ott
One-time tokens: e-mail and SMS codes and magic links as a sign-in method. The model of a stored code, the policy (lifetimes, length, attempts) and the ports for storing, generating, hashing and delivering them.
